name: chat
title: Chat
description: An AI assistant chat screen: replies stream in word by word with a soft fade and a blinking caret, a shimmering “Thinking…” waits for the first token, and the send button morphs into Stop. Light markdown (bold, inline code, lists, scrollable code blocks), suggestion chips, copy / regenerate / thumbs actions and a prompt field that grows to five lines and stays above the keyboard.
